newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot resid prices mostly firm with crude, gas.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot resid prices mostly firm with crude, gas.

text.p: U.S. spot fuel oil prices mostly firmed Tuesday in moderate trade, amid rallies in crude and natgas, and forecasts of colder East Coast weather later this week and next, sources said.

"We've got cold weather coming, and the crude and gas rally just added more fuel to the fire. There's no reason to sell it down," said one trader, referring to revised forecasts for colder weather that should stir better utility fuel burns, particularly with resid now cheaper than gas.
New York Harbor one percent gained 25 cents to $21.50-75 a barrel on prospects for better low sulphur interest.
